threads.body: Removing the `threadsSeen.add(...)` in the terminal `.map(...)` means the later `threadsSeen` assertions no longer cover the terminal stage. This makes the comment/intent (“none of the stages…”) misleading and can hide stage-4 running on the caller thread (which the PR description suggests is expected). Consider either updating the later assertion/comment to explicitly scope the check to FuturePool-serviced stages, or recording the terminal stage thread separately and asserting the intended behavior.
